title: Major disaster declaration DR-4909-HI: Flood
summary: FEMA records a major disaster declaration (DR-4909-HI, "SEVERE STORMS, FLOODING, LANDSLIDES, AND MUDSLIDES") for HI, dated 2026-04-07, for an incident of type "Flood". The incident period began on 2026-03-10 and ended on 2026-03-24. The declaration lists 3 designated areas.
